I would like to obtain additional information regarding the locking of my monthly statement for the period of {{period}}.

Thank you in advance for your assistance.

buttons.use-excel-file: Import workdays from an Excel file

success.workday-created: Your workday has been created successfully!

delete-dialog.title: Delete this workday?

creation-limit-banner.low-title: Your workday creation quota is running low
creation-limit-banner.low-description: Adding workdays is limited over a rolling 12-hour window to prevent abuse from malicious users. You have little quota left, so please wait a while before adding more workdays.
creation-limit-banner.exhausted-title: Your workday creation quota has been reached
creation-limit-banner.exhausted-description: Adding workdays is limited over a rolling 12-hour window to prevent abuse from malicious users. You've used all of your quota, so adding workdays is temporarily disabled. Please try again later.

garbage.description: Deleted workdays are automatically removed after {{retentionDays}} days.
garbage.empty-description: No deleted workdays at the moment.
garbage.restore-error: An error occurred while restoring. Please try again.

documents.generation-error: Your document cannot be retrieved at the moment. Please try again later.
documents.generated-banner-title: Some statements have been permanently generated
documents.generated-banner-description: Statements marked <badge></badge> are finalized and their workdays can no longer be edited. This happens automatically once a statement is over 3 months old.

generated-why-dialog.title: Why this process?
generated-why-dialog.description: Permanent generation was designed to improve your experience and ensure the reliability of your data.
generated-why-dialog.reason-speed-description: Finalized statements are pre-generated and instantly available, with no recalculation on each view.
generated-why-dialog.reason-performance-description: Associated workdays are removed from the active database, lightening the app and speeding up your daily actions.
generated-why-dialog.reason-integrity-description: Once finalized, a statement can no longer be modified or deleted. Your data stays reliable and compliant in case of audit or dispute.

deactivation-banner.title: Account deactivated
deactivation-banner.description: All your data will be permanently deleted on {{date}}. Restore your account from personal information to cancel its deletion.

support.description: To contact support, send an email to the address above and using your registration email address. Requests are handled within approximately one week.

pwa-update.description: A new version of the application is ready to install.

mails.description-language-notice: This description is provided in English by the system.

preferences.toggle-error: Unable to update the preference. Please try again.

descriptions.MONTHLY_REPORTS: Receive a monthly summary of your activity.

mail-preferences.support-help: If you have any questions about your notification preferences, you can contact our support.

application-preferences.banner-share-description: Invites you to share the app with other drivers.
application-preferences.banner-end-workday-rest-dialog-descripti: Asks whether you got a full night's rest at the end of each workday, when your breaks are automated.

rest-preferences.how-it-works-description: A configuration contains multiple intervals that define the break duration based on the total hours worked in the day. At the end of a workday, Plannify automatically assigns the break duration that matches the time worked.

empty-state.description: Add your first interval to automatically calculate your break time based on hours worked.

reset-dialog.description: Your configuration will be permanently deleted.

add-workday-button.manual-add-workday: Manual entry - catch up on a missed day
